Ansonia.QN: 1.  "Shall Section 43 of the City of Ansonia Charter be amended to require that the Mayor submit a proposed fiscal-year budget to the Board of Apportionment and Taxation no later than the second Monday in March each year and if a public referendum is necessary shall the timeline for the public referendum be changed to no more than fourteen calendar days and no less than ten calendar days after approval by the Board of Aldermen?"

2.  "Shall a public referendum be held on the budget for the City of Ansonia whenever the Board of Aldermen approves a budget that increases total expenditures by 4% or more compared to the prior fiscal year?"

3.  "Shall Section 129 of the City of Ansonia Charter be amended to replace references to the Fire Superintendent with Fire Chief, establish the process for selecting the second Fire Chief, and specify the appointing authority for members of the Board of Fire Commissioners?"
4.  "Shall Section 130 of the City of Ansonia Charter be eliminated as the Superintendent of Fire Alarms be obsolete?"
